motivation: The pre-loss exact-point legacy test indicates that longer uninterrupted Thalassia occupancy history is associated with later re-recording. This test asks whether the same recovery signal is also carried by focal abundance immediately before loss, separating historical persistence from current above-ground state.

source.recovery_sequence: same frozen 259 exact-point loss/recovery sequences as microsite_recovery_pathway_v1
source.abundance_measure: numeric source-year Thalassia seagrass percent cover (Braun-Blanquet scale) eMoF measurement at the same stable point

point_abundance.visit_value: For each eligible point event with Thalassia present, mean all numeric focal Braun-Blanquet measurements linked to focal occurrence rows; if focal presence has no numeric Braun-Blanquet value, visit abundance is missing.
point_abundance.source_point_year_value: Mean numeric visit values within the source calendar year at the same stable point.
point_abundance.nonnumeric_reported: Missing; never converted to a numeric class.

primary_design.population: same frozen three-year exact-point recovery sequences; retain sequences with numeric source-point-year Braun-Blanquet abundance
primary_design.informative_stratum: within a node × intermediate-state stratum, at least one return and one non-return sequence with numeric source abundance
primary_design.stratum_effect: mean source-point Braun-Blanquet abundance among return sequences minus mean among non-return sequences
primary_design.node_effect: unweighted mean informative-stratum effect within node
primary_design.support_rule: 95% bootstrap interval for the mean node effect entirely above zero

secondary_descriptive: numeric abundance coverage among the 259 recovery sequences
median node effect and positive/zero/negative node counts
source abundance distributions by return outcome
descriptive return fraction by observed source Braun-Blanquet class where n>=10

interpretation.supported: Higher focal abundance immediately before exact-point loss is associated with subsequent re-recording beyond broad transect and loss-year community state, consistent with a local state-strength/reserve proxy.
interpretation.unsupported: Immediate pre-loss Braun-Blanquet abundance does not show a robust within-node/within-loss-state association with later re-recording; any supported pre-loss history effect is therefore not reducible to the last observed abundance class.

claim_boundary: Braun-Blanquet is an ordinal above-ground abundance index, not percent cover or a direct measurement of below-ground reserves.
A positive association would not identify rhizome biomass, carbohydrate stores, clonal integration, or facilitation.
Nonnumeric focal cover values remain missing and are not recoded.
Return means re-recorded Thalassia at the same meter mark, not proven demographic recolonization.
Do not change the recovery sequence, abundance aggregation, stratification, minimum informative-node rule, bootstrap unit, or directional support rule after opening the return-abundance association.
